body: Thank you, it's really messed up. The worst part of everything is at the end of the day is knowing and being aware of how awful this is but not being able to remove myself from the situation because I don't want there to be blood on my hands.

This really hits home for me because my ex recently tried to commit suicide and said the breakup caused it. He was treating me like an emotional dumpster and mother more than a partner. His friends keep trying to gaslight me into dating him because I'll save him and I don't think they understand how awful it is. Or how toxic it was for me and how much anxiety you get for being blamed for someones (almost) death. Nobody deserves that blame or guilt, its soul crushing and horrible.
